features.feature: Canonical workspace capacity identity is derived from the git common directory, so linked worktrees serialize together while independent repositories do not.
features.source: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts derives the capacity path under the canonical git common root; packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts exercises linked-worktree sharing and independent-repository isolation.

features.feature: Every official lattice validate mode, including no-story, selective --channel/--concept/--lint, and ordinary story validation, enters the workspace capacity boundary before execution.
features.source: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts wraps the whole verifier handler in withValidationExecutionLocks; current focused/full verification pins cover every validate branch.

features.feature: done_required_validate shares the same workspace capacity boundary and retains its story-scoped inner lock and evidence behavior.
features.source: packages/main/src/handlers/done-required-validation.ts uses the official workspace-to-story wrapper; docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md preserves the separate DONE-required evidence contract.

features.feature: Derived host-verdict binding is serialized by the same official workspace-to-story lock path instead of bypassing capacity.
features.source: packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts routes submitWithDerivedBindings through withValidationExecutionLocks; the full capacity smoke covers this evidence consumer.

features.feature: Contenders wait asynchronously, emit bounded holder and heartbeat progress to stderr, and keep JSON/stdout machine-readable.
features.source: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts implements queued async acquisition and progress; packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts verifies wait/run/progress and clean JSON behavior.

features.feature: Lock order is workspace first then story, with context-local reentrancy that does not let sibling async work bypass either lock.
features.source: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts exposes the official outer-workspace/inner-story wrapper and context-local ownership; focused/full smoke assertions cover order and sibling isolation.

features.feature: Capacity stale-owner reclamation uses a capacity-specific strict liveness classifier; unknown, malformed, and age-only owners are not reclaimed, and the legacy story-lock classifier is unchanged.
features.source: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts separates strict capacity owner classification from the legacy story-lock path; focused/full smoke includes ownerless-age, malformed, and unknown cases.

features.feature: Queue publication is complete before eligibility, and stale reclamation uses UUID quarantine plus compare/recheck semantics to avoid partial-owner and ABA races.
features.source: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts uses preparing/choosing publication and quarantined stale entries; packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts covers partial publication and ABA-safe recovery.

features.feature: Abort, deadline, callback throw, and release failures clean queue/owner artifacts without masking the original validation result or error.
features.source: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts contains abort/deadline/release cleanup paths; the full capacity smoke asserts recovery and original-error truth.

features.feature: The lock covers evidence publication as part of the critical section while routine validation evidence and DONE-required evidence remain separate and freshness-bound.
features.source: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts and packages/main/src/handlers/done-required-validation.ts keep evidence writes inside the wrapper; testing-infra.md and done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md retain distinct evidence semantics.

features.feature: Existing validation budgets, command inventory, and read-only commands remain unchanged.
features.source: Scope contract protects package/config/full-suite inventory surfaces; scope_contract_check reports zero violations and the declared changes do not alter budgets or read-only command handling.

features.feature: CLI help and decision documentation describe shared capacity, wait behavior, lock order, and the boundary between Lattice commands and bare npm execution.
features.source: packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts, docs/CLI.md, docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md, and docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md contain the aligned boundary and recovery text.

features.feature: All focused/full verification pins use the current exact smoke terminals 14/25, with no stale 5/16 selector remaining.
features.source: CLI checklist_get enumeration shows focused selector 14 and full selector 25 throughout; packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts emits those exact terminals.

features.feature: Managed checklist_update can round-trip strict verification pin objects so selector repair is possible through the authorized interface without direct Story JSON edits or planned-path loss.
features.source: packages/main/src/cli/command-schemas.ts adds strict command/selector pin validation; packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts verifies preservation and rejects empty, missing, or unknown pin fields.

features.feature: ProofStory pre-review acceptance uses an exact 58-assertion terminal selector and rejects stale, count-free, or suffixed near-matches.
features.source: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts defines the exact PASS (58 assertions) terminal and adversarial near-match checks; CHK-004 pins that live acceptance contract.

features.feature: Direct interception or wrapping of bare npm test is intentionally outside this Story.
features.excluded_by: CHK-001, CHK-003 and decision option D
features.source: Understanding, decision, scope contract, and docs consistently state that bare npm test is outside the Lattice command capacity boundary.

features.feature: Doctor, runtime-fact registry, runtime-artifact registry, and process-fact registry changes are intentionally excluded because the existing .lattice/locks registry already covers these lock artifacts and no new gate fact is introduced.
features.source: Current design reuses registered lock storage and existing command/evidence semantics; scope contract explicitly excludes these registry and doctor surfaces.
